title: InfoVis: Unified Slide Image Generation and Editing
abstract: arXiv:2610.16784v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Generating and editing presentation slides requires models to combine accurate text rendering, instruction following, visual grounding, aesthetic design, and precise editing within one canvas. Existing work covers only subsets of these capabilities and lacks large-scale slide-native supervision and diagnostic evaluation. We formulate four slide-centric tasks and build a scalable data engine with over 13M continual-pretraining records and 1.9M supervised fine-tuning records. We also introduce VisSlideBench, a benchmark of 1,527 manually screened instances that covers all four tasks with task-specific, multidimensional evaluation. Its automatic rankings agree with blinded, dimension-wise human rankings. Using these resources, we train InfoVis, a unified 9B slide generation and editing model. On VisSlideBench, InfoVis leads every evaluated open-source model on all eleven metrics and scores 7.94 overall against 7.99 for Nano-Banana-2. Star

translated_title: InfoVis：统一的幻灯片图像生成与编辑
translated_abstract: 生成和编辑演示幻灯片要求模型在同一画布上结合精确的文本渲染、指令遵循、视觉定位、美学设计和精准编辑等多种能力。现有工作仅涵盖这些能力的部分子集，且缺乏大规模的幻灯片原生监督数据和诊断性评估。我们制定了四项以幻灯片为中心的任务，并构建了一个可扩展的数据引擎，包含超过1300万条持续预训练记录和190万条监督微调记录。我们还推出了VisSlideBench基准，包含1527个经人工筛选的实例，覆盖全部四项任务，并提供针对每项任务的多维度评估，其自动排名与盲评的、按维度的人工排名保持一致。利用这些资源，我们训练了InfoVis，一个统一的90亿参数幻灯片生成与编辑模型。在VisSlideBench上，InfoVis在全部11项指标上领先于所有被评估的开源模型，总分为7.94，与闭源模型Nano-Banana-2的7.99分接近。
tldr: 该论文提出了统一的90亿参数幻灯片生成与编辑模型InfoVis，通过构建包含超1300万条预训练和190万条微调记录的数据引擎以及VisSlideBench多维度基准，在全部11项指标上超越所有开源模型，并逼近闭源模型Nano-Banana-2的性能。
en_tdlr: The paper introduces InfoVis, a unified 9B slide generation and editing model trained on a scalable data engine with 13M pretraining and 1.9M fine-tuning records, which outperforms all evaluated open-source models across all eleven metrics on the newly proposed VisSlideBench benchmark and approaches the closed-source Nano-Banana-2.
